hooks.command: IN=$(cat); AID=$(printf "%s" "$IN" | jq -r ".agent_id // empty"); [ -n "$AID" ] && exit 0; FP=$(printf "%s" "$IN" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$FP" in */CLAUDE.md) exit 0;; */LingoSquared/frontend/*|*/LingoSquared/backend/*|*/LingoSquared/packages/*|*/LingoSquared/scripts/*|*/LingoSquared/e2e/*|*/LingoSquared/mobile/*|*/LingoSquared/docs/content/*) jq -n "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Coordinator no-inline-coding rule (Ramin 2026-08-03): dispatch this edit to a sub-agent or Codex instead. (Sub-agents are exempt from this hook.)\"}}";; esac

IN=$(cat); AID=$(printf "%s" "$IN" | jq -r ".agent_id // empty"); C=$(printf "%s" "$IN" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); deny(){ jq -n --arg r "$1" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\$r}}"; exit 0; }; case "$C" in *"git add -A"*|*"git add --all"*|*"git add ."|*"git add . "*|*"git add . &&"*) deny "Repo rule: never broad-stage (git add -A/.) — stage explicit pathspecs (swept concurrent sessions twice; BUILD_LOG 2026-07-06/07/08).";; esac; case "$C" in *"git worktree remove"*--force*) deny "Repo rule: no worktree remove --force — it silently destroys uncommitted work (7 dispatches lost; BUILD_LOG 2026-07-10). Run without --force first.";; esac; case "$C" in *"git stash list"*) :;; *"git stash"*) deny "Repo rule: never git stash in multi-session work — the stash stack is shared repo-wide (BUILD_LOG 2026-07-10). Use a scratch commit or diff file.";; esac; if [ -n "$AID" ]; then case "$C" in *"git push"*) deny "Repo rule: workers never push — only the coordinator pushes after verified merges.";; esac; fi; case "$C" in *"compose run"*pytest*|*"compose exec"*pytest*) case "$C" in *_test*) :;; *) deny "Repo rule: pytest only against an isolated *_test DB — a shared-DB run wiped the dev DB (2026-08-02). Rewrite DATABASE_URL to lingosquared_test.";; esac;; esac
